class.name: VASource
class.description: A spatialised 3D sound source that casts its own raytracing rays for reverb, ambience, and visualisation (see [VARaytracedSource]), and plays a fixed [AudioStream] resource decoded once up front. Muffling (occlusion/permeation) is applied to it by the listener's own rays, so this node never casts occlusion or permeation rays itself - use [VAEmitter]'s occlusion/permeation settings on the listener to control muffling. If [member ALSource.autoplay] is [code]true[/code] and [method play] is called (including the automatic call on [code]_ready[/code]) before this source's emitter has produced any raytracing results yet, playback is deferred and starts automatically as soon as those results are available.
